accuracy.route: OSM trace checked against BYU 2016 marked photograph; not a surveyed route or present-day signage inventory
accuracy.checkpoints: Twelve ordered mapped-bend game checkpoints; official sign positions unverified

accuracy.trailGrade: Unsmoothed triangulated 3m DEM shared by visible terrain and collision; 2.4m width is authored, not a survey
accuracy.campusConnection: Assisted trip from campus. The intervening streets are not modeled as walkable geography.

dem.attribution: Elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

byuReference.comparison: Measured source route retained without length/elevation scaling; source route ends at upper-Y arm and differs from publication's endpoints/measurement.
